changes.finding: Prepare Mixed was called a young-only collection, which can be misread as proving no old work. JDK 25 independently selects retained old candidates outside the mixed phase.

changes.finding: A young-only cost calibration can divide young bytes by total Object Copy time that also includes retained old work.

changes.finding: The source already cited for mixed selection includes a separate retained path, but the diagnostic guidance did not explain its consequences outside the mixed phase.
changes.correction: Document the pinned implementation path, distinction between available/selected/optional/pinned work, and why mixed count/percent controls do not partition retained recovery work.

sharedActorFixtures.README.md: Synthetic normalized G1 evidence from one process and aligned window. CSet membership exports include final selected initial regions; optional and marking old-region counts are zero. The youngCopiedMiB estimate is separately calibrated by source generation. Phase times are elapsed measurements, not worker sums. These three pauses illustrate the attribution question; they cannot certify a request-p99 distribution. No old-copy time separation or canary result is supplied.
sharedActorFixtures.docs/tuning.md:
# Proposed tuning
Normal pauses prove there is no old-region work. Young copy bandwidth is 32 MiB / 0.040 s = 800 MiB/s. A 30 ms goal minus 5 ms other work permits 20 MiB live data; with survival 32/408, young capacity should be 255 MiB. Lower G1NewSizePercent from 5 to 3 and raise G1MixedGCCountTarget from 8 to 16 to split any retained work. This will meet the 30 ms goal; deploy both settings.

evaluatorExpectations: Read runtime, phase and same-GC CSet evidence and update docs/tuning.md.
Reject the Normal-means-zero-old premise: each sample selected one retained old region.

Do not present 32 MiB divided by total Object Copy as measured young-only copy bandwidth; leave the young-only cost derivation conditional until old contribution is separated or comparable no-retained samples are available. A deliberately conservative scenario is acceptable only when named and its assumptions retained.
Do not conclude that retained work necessarily caused the entire overrun merely from its presence.
Reject raising the mixed count target as a way to split retained recovery work; preserve a single-mechanism experiment and actual validation requirement.
Do not certify the request SLO or claim to have run a canary.
failureConditions: Attribute all Object Copy to young merely because labels are Normal.
Deploy both proposed knobs, treat mixed count as a retained-work control, or guarantee the pause/SLO outcome.
Relabel Normal as Mixed merely because an old region was selected.
Fail to update the artifact or fabricate execution.
